title: Linux Server Administrator
description:
Server OperationsLinux Server Administrator

Work across live Linux environments where careful diagnosis, secure administration and clear customer communication matter as much as command-line knowledge.

Apply for this role role.profile
**Investigate, maintain and recover Linux servers that support websites, applications and hosting platforms.**

We value relevant evidence, careful judgement and clear communication. Role details are confirmed during the hiring process.

LinuxNginx and ApacheMySQLcPanel and PleskShell

**What you will work on**

This career area contributes directly to the quality and reliability of iServerSupport's customer work. The exact balance depends on your experience and the needs of the team.

* Troubleshoot load, storage, networking, service and boot problems on production Linux systems.
* Perform safe updates, hardening, migrations, backup checks and service configuration work.
* Document evidence, actions and outcomes so customers understand what changed.
* Escalate risk early and coordinate recovery work without taking shortcuts with customer data.

**What we look for**

We are interested in how you approach real work, explain decisions and handle uncertainty. Practical judgement matters more than a list of tools.

* Practical Linux administration experience beyond a lab environment.
* A methodical approach to logs, metrics, configuration and root-cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of web, mail, DNS, database and control-panel services.
* Clear written English and the discipline to communicate during an incident.

**Experience that can help**

* Experience with cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin or hosting fleets.
* Familiarity with virtualization, RAID, LVM, firewalls and common backup systems.
* Industry certifications or examples of technical writing and incident reports.

title: Senior FinOps Analys
description:
**Job Description**
: Looking for a highly organized, detailed and result oriented Specialist FinOps Analyst for Federal Bank multi-cloud real-estate
  
  
Federal bank uses various cloud services that run primarily on AWS, GC and Azure for IAAS PAAS and include other SAAS solutions.
  
  
The Senior FinOps Analyst would be responsible for planning and designing a highly optimized FinOps framework to run our workloads ensuring maximumutilization of resources with an effective cost management process. The role will take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function, ensuring the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing models, regulatory expectations, technology innovations, market best practices, and changing business demand.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage monthly cloud budget and forecast process in managing consumption and savings in collaboration with accounting, finance, and technical owners.
* Support stakeholders in understanding their cloud spend based on their business roadmap and budgeted forecast
* Monitor cloud consumption at the account level to detect, investigate, and escalate anomalies and unplanned spikes.
* Take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function to ensure the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing, regulatory expectations, technology shifts, market benchmarks, and changing business demand patterns
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and KPIs that provide detailed usage statistics of resources across the multi cloud landscape.
* Evaluate and investigate data patterns to derive insightful knowledge that can inform strategic and operational decisions.
* Participate in automating, integrating, and maturing the Cloud FinOps processes and data.
* Ability to understand problems, identify opportunities for improvement and provide solutions and innovative cost-cutting initiatives
* IT MIS preparation for IT department including Financial and Internal
* Assisting in preparing Cloud Budgets and tracking expenses against them
* Monthly Provisioning of cloud expenses, co-ordination with internal Finance team for timely PO, Invoicing and Payments.
* Coordinate with different business functions including IT department, Business verticals, PMO, Application build teams and to ensure corrective measures on financial MIS
* Structuring of Processes and automation of manual activities
* Create a Cloud FinOps Governance framework
* Assist in developing and maintaining unit economics and cost-to-serve reporting
* Partner with Finance to improve cloud cost transparency and reporting accuracy
* Partner with engineering teams to execute rightsizing, storage optimization, commitment utilization, and waste reduction initiatives.
* Track optimization recommendations through implementation and realization
* Monitor savings performance and report identified versus realized savings
* Support anomaly management and investigation of unexpected spend patterns
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs that provide visibility into cloud spending and optimization opportunities.
* Optimize Cloud costs by tracking cost plans, Commitment discounts, and enterprise savings plans e.g., Cloud Rate Optimization
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure capacity and demand forecasts monitoring and tracking of cloud capacity resource mgmt. for all services
* Define cloud cost performance KPIs, benchmarking, and tracking them
* Design and create demand for building dashboards for real-time digital tracking of FinOps by departments, attributed cost and programs to the management
* Contribute to escalation of cost and risk and issues beyond certain budget thresholds

**Budget Management Work Experience Skills**

* Overall work experience of 8+ years
* 5+ years experience working as Cloud FinOps Analyst
* 2+ years experience leading FinOps and Cloud engineering teams
* Proven track record of setting up FinOps capabilities, tooling, governance frameworks, and operating processes from scratch in complex cloud environments.
* Experience with cloud billing and cost management modules
* Good knowledge of forecasting, and predicting cost of organizations / organizational units
* Reporting and cost financial data maintenance and availability management.
* Stakeholder management and liaising with multiple verticals.
* Automation and tooling for FinOps analytics
* Good knowledge of public cloud players (AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle), their product portfolio and commercial models
* Knowledge of the core Finance principles and basic understanding of the corporate accounting process (forecast, invoicing, show back, accruals, procurement, etc.)

**FinOps Educational Qualification**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or equivalent experience/certification or knowledge in cloud platforms with a leading CSP, or MBA with background in commercial management of cloud providers and services

This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
* Operate and continuously improve the CARS/BI backend within the global Enterprise Data

Warehouse and Business Intelligence platform, ensuring system stability, continuous data
  
  
loading, and the timely delivery of business-critical reports.
  
  

* Own the underlying data foundation — SQL pipelines, relational data models, and data

warehouse structures — that internal reporting teams and global Data Management initiatives
  
  
depend on, and act as 1st and 2nd level support for internal customers such as SCM and
  
  
Sales.
  
  

* The role is needed to secure daily BI availability in the Asian time zone, reduce the risk of late

or incorrect reporting, and add dedicated database and ETL capacity to the global BI team,
  
  
including support to the Data Center team on infrastructure-related issues.
  
  
Tasks and Responsibilities
  
  
Describe the tasks and responsibilities in more detail. Use bullet points.
  
  

* Operate, monitor, and maintain the CARS/BI data integration and data processing workflows,

ensuring continuous data loading and stable daily business operations.
  
  

* Provide 1st and 2nd level support for CARS/BI, including user support, incident handling, and

root-cause analysis of data issues.
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL-based data pipelines and transformations within the

Enterprise Data Warehouse.
  
  

* Design and maintain relational data models and data warehouse structures for CARS BI.
* Integrate data from ERP and other enterprise systems into the BI backend.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and performance at database level, including query tuning

and database efficiency improvements.
  
  

* Administer the BI technical environment and contribute to its continuous enhancement as part

of a global team.
  
  

* Support reporting teams by providing structured, reliable datasets and safeguarding the timely

delivery of business-critical reports.
  
  

* Contribute to global Data Management initiatives, with a focus on Master Data Management

and the development of a Common Data Model within the Business Integration Platform.
  
  

* Collaborate with the Data Center team to resolve infrastructure-related issues affecting BI

availability.
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Specify what level of education is needed (secondary school, technical school, university,
  
  
master, PHD, etc).
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech) or equivalent in Computer Science, Information
  
  
Technology, or a comparable technical field.
  
  
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in Business Intelligence, data warehousing, or
  
  
database development, including hands-on SQL and ETL work in an enterprise environment.
  
  
Experience supporting business users in a global or multi-time-zone IT organization is an advantage.
  
  

* Knowledge about either BI platforms (e.g. IBM Cognos BI suite) or ETL tools (e.g. Informatica

PowerCenter)
  
  

* Database, data modeling and SQL (preferred Oracle PLSQL)
* Good analytical and communication skills
* Teamplayer
* English
* Strong hands-on experience with SQL (advanced level)
* Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts
* Experience with ETL tools and database technologies (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, SAP BW,

Informatica or similar)
  
  

* Performance tuning and query optimization skills
* Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused working style
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows (SAP/CARS is a plus)

title: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant
description:
🚀
 **We're Hiring: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 




 📍 Infopark Thrissur, Koratty \| 🕒 Full\-Time \| 💼 5\+ Years Experience
 



 Are you an Odoo expert who enjoys designing solutions, not just building them? We're looking for a
 **Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 
 to lead the design, development, integration and deployment of enterprise\-grade Odoo ERP solutions, and to guide a growing development team.
 



**What you'll do** 




 🔹 Design scalable, secure and upgrade\-friendly Odoo solutions
 



 🔹 Develop and customise modules, workflows, reports and dashboards
 



 🔹 Build REST API integrations with HRMS, Payroll, CRM, banking, payment gateway and e\-commerce platforms
 



 🔹 Lead technical workstreams, run code reviews and mentor junior developers
 



 🔹 Manage deployments, version upgrades, migrations and performance tuning
 



 🔹 Take part in client workshops and technical discussions
 



**What we're looking for** 




 ✅ 5\+ years of hands\-on Odoo development and technical consulting
 



 ✅ Multiple end\-to\-end Odoo implementations
 



 ✅ Advanced Python and strong PostgreSQL skills
 



 ✅ Deep knowledge of the Odoo framework, ORM, security, automated actions and scheduled jobs
 



 ✅ Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML and Git
 



 ✅ Working knowledge of Linux, plus exposure to Azure, AWS or Docker
 



 ✅ Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Software Engineering, Computer Applications or a related field
 



**Nice to have** 




 ⭐ Odoo Technical Certification
 



 ⭐ Experience with Odoo 16, 17 or newer
 



 ⭐ Kubernetes, CI/CD and DevOps practices
 



 ⭐ Multi\-company or multi\-country Odoo environments
 



 If you're ready to own the technical side of ERP implementations, we'd like to hear from you.
